approve.reason: Union University Scholarship: one award per column of the table captioned '2026 Freshman Academic Awards' under '2026-27 Union UG Merit Scholarships'; criteria and amounts copied from the rows 'MinimumACT / SAT / CLT', 'Minimum GPA', 'On-Campus Award Amount' and 'Off-Campus Award Amount'; the printed ACT and SAT minimums are stored beside the GPA minimum (one number per named test, in the printed order; the CLT minimum stays in the text). 'For students enrolling in Fall 2026, eligibility for freshman merit scholarships is based on both test score and GPA minimums.' 'Merit awards are higher for students who choose to live on campus.' 'To apply for any of the following, complete the Undergraduate Admissions Application.' Period: 'Most institutional scholarships at Union are renewable, meaning students can continue to receive them each academic year if the eligibility requirements are met.' Year 2026-27 printed; no open issue.
